title: Grateful Dead Live at Rossevelt Stadium on 1972-07-18

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1972 show captured on a soundboard with mostly crisp audio (minor dropout at the end) and standout performances of Jack Straw, Truckin > Dark Star > Comes A Time, and Playing In The Band.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its vintage 1972 vibe, tight playing and soaring vocals from both Jerry and Bob, with Keith’s lighter boogie‑woogie piano adding sparkle. Highlights include the back‑to‑back Garcia tunes, an inspired Dark Star jam, and a monster Playing In The Band stretch, while the soundboard drops out briefly toward the end.

ai_rating.rationale: The review is overwhelmingly enthusiastic about the performance and notes only a small recording glitch, leading to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear with pristine vocals; a brief dropout toward the end is noted but does not detract significantly from overall listenability.

standout_songs: Truckin > Dark Star > Comes A Time
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly, featuring two Garcia-led numbers back‑to‑back and extended jams that build momentum toward a powerful second‑half climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals pristine; lost a few lyrics in Loser but performance still strong.
band_member_comments.Phil: Sings loudly on "B.E. Women" and generally solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal delivery praised as pristine alongside Jerry.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's lighter, boogie‑woogie piano adds sparkle, especially noticeable on the B.I.O.D.T.L. segment.
